title: Inter 3-0 Feyenoord: the derby answer, and Sky says Dimarco to 2028 #Shorts

CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Nov 3): Feyenoord 0-3 Inter. Bisseck 8', Esposito 34', Zielinski 54'. Six points from four, 14th of 36 in the league phase.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews (Nov 3): a clause ties Federico Dimarco to June 30, 2028. Inter have announced nothing.
